recap.analyst:
Harbor City and Thames Rovers drew 3-3. On expected goals it finished 0.60–1.26: Thames Rovers did enough to win on chances and will feel they dropped points.

Harbor City had 59% of the ball. Pass completion HAR 82% (146/178), TRV 67% (91/136). Shots 4–6, on target 2–3.

Harbor City started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Thames Rovers in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: HAR to 3-4-3 at 68' (chasing the game).

Turning point, 70': Harbor City levelled the match through P. Reyes. The chance was worth xG 0.28 (about 28 in 100 go in), struck at 111 km/h. Score now HAR 3-3 TRV.

By the numbers: S. Nakamura completed the most passes (26); Z. Keane hit the top speed (33.2 km/h); N. Xhaka covered the most ground (6.43 km, a 17.5 km per-90 pace); B. Fuentes won the most challenges (11).

Discipline: fouls 3–4, yellows 1–0, offsides 0–1. Conditions: partly cloudy, 19°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: What a game at The Arch, London. G. Petit broke the deadlock in the 11th minute. G. Petit struck in the 28th for Thames Rovers. N. Xhaka struck in the 45th for Thames Rovers. Then an own goal in the 64th gave Harbor City another. P. Reyes struck in the 68th for Harbor City. P. Reyes struck in the 70th for Harbor City. Harbor City had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: G. Petit, with 2 goals. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
